original_question.question: A solid rectangular block has width 16, depth 4, and height 8. Measure x horizontally from its left end. A rectangular section (or sections) is removed all the way through the depth as follows: from x = 4 to x = 13, remove everything above height 3. The figure shows the remaining solid; dashed lines indicate some edges of the original block before cutting. All cuts are perpendicular to the faces of the block. By what percentage does the total surface area decrease? Give the exact percentage.
